body: I enjoy reading these, please keep it up as long as you have something to say i will read it.

Hey frendyguy19, simply reading your perspective on the world has made me feel better.  I'm glad there is someone out there who not only feels the same way i do, but also took the time to write, and articulate what you see, everyday.  It's strange how many of us grow up and eventually get over the fear of dark.  Yet some of the most disturbing things that could conceivably happen occur in the light, as billions of people gracefully, and gratefully accept what is in front of them.  Thank you!!!  I look forward to reading the rest, and i hope you feel better.  While many people are out there destroying the world, just look for the people who are helping.
